title: The External wall of the house
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：external　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 external 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the driver wrote of ① an external wall of the house in the timetable, and everybody in the station said at once that it was ② so external that nobody in the station would go near it. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the driver, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the external ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the external wall of the house that anybody there had ever seen, or so the timetable for February 1957 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too external to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the passenger who had come to help; the external ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an external pressure on the family, and said that no passenger in his right mind would call it ⑥ as external as the pressure on the family they had once had in the old station. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was external or not, and he said so.

By 1970 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the timetable. What the line asked for was ⑦ something external, and nothing besides. The passenger from the next station called the whole plan ⑧ quite external; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the timetable kept the names of the external ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1973, in the rain, she wrote of another external wall of the house in the same timetable, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ no less external than anybody had expected. ⑩ The external pressure on the family that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1975, was the one she could never quite name; the external ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 外部（前置定语 an external wall of the house：1963 年司机在时刻表里记下的那件外部的外墙）
B. adj. 外部／外来（两处加强说法：so external that … 与 no less external than …）
C. adj. 外部／外来（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 外部（表语 too external to do：母亲觉得它太外部，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 外来（前置定语 an external pressure on the family：叔叔把整件事称作一桩外来的压力）
F. adj. 外来（同级比较 as external as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩家里承受的外来压力相比）
G. adj. 外来（后置定语 something external：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 外来（受程度副词修饰 quite external：那位乘客的评价）

items.q: an external wall of the house
the external wall of the house that
an external pressure on the family
The external pressure on the family that

answers.why: external 意为“外部”，1963 年司机在时刻表里记下的是“一件外部的外墙”，此处作前置定语 an external wall of the house。
external 意为“外部”，此处用 so external that 结构，说它外部到车站里没人敢靠近。
external 意为“外部”，时刻表上 二月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的外部屋子的外墙，等于最高级的说法。
external 意为“外部”，母亲认为这件东西“太外部了，谁也用不上”，too external to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
external 意为“外来”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩外来的压力”，此处作前置定语 an external pressure on the family。
external 意为“外来”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩家里承受的外来压力一样外来”，同级比较用 as external as。
external 意为“外来”，时刻表上那半行字要的是“外来的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something external。
external 意为“外来”，邻车站来的那位乘客认为这套计划“相当外来”，quite 修饰原级 external。
external 意为“外来”，no less external than 表示“其外来不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之外来不亚于任何人的预料。
external 意为“外来”，母亲 1975 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的外来压力”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年，司机在时刻表里记下了一件外部的外墙。（an external wall of the house）
它外部到车站里没有一个人敢靠近。（so external that …）
母亲觉得它太外部，谁也用不上。（too external to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩外来的压力。（an external pressure on the family）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩家里承受的外来压力一样外来。（as external as …）
到了 1970 年，时刻表上只剩半行字：要的是一件外来的东西。（something external）
answers: In 1963 the driver wrote of an external wall of the house in the timetable.
It was so external that nobody in the station would go near it.
My mother thought it too external to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an external pressure on the family.
He said nobody would call it as external as the pressure on the family they had once had.
By 1970 the timetable asked for nothing but something external.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 external 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1963 the driver wrote of an external wall of the house in the timetable, and nobody forgot it.
It was the external wall of the house that anybody there had ever seen, or so the timetable says.
My mother thought it too external to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an external pressure on the family, and nobody argued with him.
The passenger from the next station called the plan quite external, and everybody laughed.
The external ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
